newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Aztech expects revenues from new products.
newsitem.headline: Aztech expects revenues from new products.

text.p: Multi-media company Aztech Systems Ltd said on Tuesday it expects to see revenues from two newly-launched products, a multimedia chipset and a desktop photo developer, during the second half of 1997.
In a statement accompanying its full year results, the company said it expects a satisfactory performance this year.

"The electronics industry entered into a consolidation phase during 1996. With this consolidation and consequently lower inventory levels, the electronics industry is expected to stabilize in the current year," the statement said.
The statement said a 36-percent decrease in the company's 1996 turnover was caused in large part by industry price erosion of CD-ROM drives and sound cards.
Aztech earlier reported a net loss for 1996 of Singapore $12.47 million, comoared with a net profit of S$25.3 million the year before.
